suggest.ext-mysqli: Native driver for mysql/mariadb (default when available)
suggest.ext-pdo_mysql: PDO fallback for mysql, or the explicit pdo_mysql driver
suggest.ext-pdo_pgsql: Required for postgresql, pgsql and postgres
suggest.ext-pdo_sqlite: Required for sqlite (used by tests and examples)
suggest.ext-pdo_sqlsrv: Required for sqlserver, sqlsrv and mssql
suggest.ext-pdo_firebird: PDO Firebird driver used on PHP 8+
